users.notes: One hardcoded row seeded idempotently ('user' / bcrypt('password')). Schema supports more rows for future multi-user; MVP only ever reads/writes this one.

columns.user_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

sessions.notes: Opaque token (secrets.token_urlsafe) in an HttpOnly cookie. 7-day TTL checked in app.auth.get_current_user.

columns.user_id: INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

boards.notes: UNIQUE on user_id enforces the MVP's 1-board-per-user rule at the DB level. Created lazily on first GET /api/board for a user.

columns.board_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL

columns_table.notes: Exactly 5 rows per board, seeded once when the board is created and never added to or removed (business rule: 'fixed columns that can be renamed'). id values are fixed and match the frontend's initialData ids (col-backlog, col-discovery, col-progress, col-review, col-done) so no id-translation layer is needed between frontend and DB. position (0-4) fixes display order.

columns.board_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.column_id: TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES columns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL

cards.notes: id is the frontend-generated card id (createId('card')), reused as-is. position is the card's index within its column's cardIds array; PUT /api/board re-derives it from array order on every write (delete+reinsert, per docs/PLAN.md Part 6). board_id is denormalized onto cards (in addition to being reachable via column_id) purely to make 'load all cards for board X' a single indexed lookup rather than a join, since every read is board-scoped.
